text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’d be a strong fit for your MERN project, especially the backend work in Node.js and guiding the team through completion. I’ve built a streaming tutoring chat for Quillstack, where I handled the front end and Node proxy for token-by-token answers. That setup delivered the first token on screen in about 600 ms and supported 30k chats a month.

I’m comfortable working closely with a team, keeping the backend clean, reliable, and easy to integrate with the rest of the app. If helpful, I can jump in quickly and focus on the Node.js backend and API integration over the next 10 days.
